headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a crucial win over the Cleveland Guardians, while the Miami Marlins shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Chicago Cubs took down the Washington Nationals in an 8-6 victory. The Seattle Mariners fell short against the New York Yankees, and the Minnesota Twins edged out the Baltimore Orioles in a thrilling 7-5 win.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. The Detroit Tigers placed Riley Greene on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Colorado Rockies placed Kyle Karros on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Athletics also placed José Suarez on the 15-day injured list with a right hip strain. Other notable injuries include Blake Treinen's transfer to the 60-day injured list for the Los Angeles Dodgers and Kervin Castro's placement on the 15-day injured list for the New York Yankees.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place in the past few days. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals traded for Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4, securing a crucial win. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 4-1 loss to the New York Yankees, with Randy Arozarena leading the team in batting with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles, handing their opponents a tough loss. Impact hitters from both teams included Pete Alonso, Dylan Beavers, Leody Taveras, Royce Lewis, Josh Bell, Brooks Lee, Victor Caratini, and Alan Roden.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a one-sided matchup, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Bohm and Alec Burleson were notable contributors for the Phillies, while Kyle Leahy stood out on the mound for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Greene Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers left fielder Riley Greene has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
